audit.whatIsWrong: Several fields called Lissandra's self-cast R a 'self-stun', and wants.you[1] said 'Use W to block his Q-poke and windwall-less all-ins' — W is a root, it blocks nothing, and 'windwall-less' is leaked Yasuo phrasing. The matchup also never mentioned Spirit Cleave's shield.
audit.why: Riot's text: cast on herself, Frozen Tomb makes Lissandra untargetable and invulnerable while healing — there is no stun on the self-cast. Spirit Cleave is a 14s cone that shields Yone and scales the shield with champions hit, which is exactly the burst-absorb the missing-interactions file flags.
audit.corrected: Self-R described as untargetable/invulnerable; W described as a 450 root; Spirit Cleave's 14s shield stated in cooldowns, whys[5] and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side read Skill on all seven rows; content win[N] and the packet levelChart both read Lissandra/Skill/Lissandra/Lissandra/Lissandra/Yone/Yone. The lane's actual shape — early Lissandra, late Yone — was erased.
audit.why: Mortal Steel is 450 range against Ice Shard's 725, so a melee Yone pays to farm through levels 1-5; from first item Spirit Cleave's cooldown shortens with attack speed and Fate Sealed pulls from 1000, which is where he takes the duel back.
audit.corrected: Full chart moved to match content and packet, every side edit paired with its rewritten why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item and 2+ item phases said Lissandra opens fights, contradicting the content layer's handover to Yone.
audit.why: Frozen Tomb is 120/100/80s and Fate Sealed is 120/100/80s too, but his Soul Unbound falls from 22s to 10s while your E only reaches 12s — his re-engage rate outruns yours once items land.
audit.corrected: phases[5] and phases[6] now describe Yone taking over and your kit converting to peel.

audit.whatIsWrong: lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT — breakdown.cooldowns held no number.
audit.why: Soul Unbound halving from 22s to 10s is the single number that explains why the lane flips.
audit.corrected: Soul Unbound 22s/10s, Spirit Cleave 14s, Frozen Tomb 120s/80s written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED on dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d.
audit.why: Both were the trade strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d rewritten around Ice Shard's shards passing through the target; dontsFull[2].d around Fate Sealed's 1000 range against your 1050 claw.

notes: Two recurring errors fixed: Lissandra's self-cast R called a 'self-stun' (Riot's text gives untargetable, invulnerable and a heal — the stun is the enemy-cast), and wants.you[1] describing W as a block plus leaked 'windwall-less' Yasuo phrasing. Chart: full layer read Skill on all seven rows while content matched the packet exactly (Lissandra early, Yone from first item); only the full layer moved, each side edit paired with its why. No win[N] edits were possible — content already holds the correct values. The missingInteractions shield entry is now stated: Spirit Cleave shields every 14s and scales with champions hit, so it must be forced out before the commit. Not asserted (kit silent): whether Ring of Frost's root interrupts Mortal Steel's dash mid-flight, whether Soul Unbound's spirit form can be rooted or tombed, and whether Fate Sealed's pull is cleansable. Yone is male; pronouns unchanged.
